localizedValues.name: Equestrian Arena
localizedValues.description: The equestrian arena is fenced and unsheltered. There is one water spigot and two electrical outlets. Use of the announcer’s stand, obstacle course, and round pen are not included in this reservation. Any individual or business using the arena for any paid instruction or class must also possess a Commercial Use Permit or a Special Activities Permit issued from Washington State Parks. For more information on permits, contact Riverside State Park at 509-465-5064.
